assets.promptExact: DEAD SECTOR retro Victorian horror FPS game texture. Image1 is identity reference: use ONLY its upper burgundy damask wallpaper, keeping its muted burgundy and dull ochre colors and broad floral scroll language. Image2 (portrait) is style reference for antique palette and deliberate pixel clusters, do not copy the face or frame. Generate ONE seamless square tile of WALLPAPER ONLY, with matching left/right AND top/bottom edges. Fill the entire canvas with wallpaper. Low contrast between the warm dark burgundy ground and the subdued brown-ochre floral pattern; broad clean simplified clusters and lots of calm negative space. Two interlocking damask repeats across the square, not dozens of tiny flowers. Controlled pixel art steps that survive export at256x256, no fine noise, no photographic grain. Uniform flat albedo, no directional lighting, shadows, vignette, glowing gold or gradients across the whole tile. No wood panels, rail, trim, border, furniture, portrait, text, logo or perspective. Matte aged wallpaper, restrained wear. The result will tile every2.1meters on tall walls, while separate existing wooden wainscoting stays1.05meters tall. Requested512x512, opaque background, true seamless texture.
